name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or capability enhancement for Waymesh
title: '[FEAT] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement.

## Motivation & Use Case
Why is this needed? What problem does this solve for commuters, drivers, or community node operators?

## Protocol / Architectural Impact
Which crates or components would this touch?
- [ ] `waymesh-core` (Data models, state machines, crypto)
- [ ] `waymesh-solver` (Optimization heuristics, algorithm adapters)
- [ ] `waymesh-server` (Axum REST API, PostGIS queries, SSE bus)
- [ ] `waymesh-mcp` (Conversational AI tool schemas)
- [ ] Connectors (ChatGPT / Claude / OpenWebUI)
- [ ] Deployment / Infrastructure

## Proposed Implementation (Optional)
Ideas on how to implement this while maintaining protocol principles (decoupled solver, sound money, privacy).
